scripts.db:drop: uv run python -m pdf_extract db drop
scripts.db:create: uv run python -m pdf_extract db create
scripts.data:pull: uv run python -m pdf_extract data pull
scripts.data:status: uv run python -m pdf_extract data status
scripts.data:prune: uv run python -m pdf_extract data prune
scripts.detect: uv run python -m pdf_extract detect run
scripts.detect:apply: uv run python -m pdf_extract detect apply
scripts.verify: uv run python -m pdf_extract verify run
scripts.verify:apply: uv run python -m pdf_extract verify apply
scripts.geocode: uv run python -m pdf_extract geocode run
scripts.geocode:apply: uv run python -m pdf_extract geocode apply
scripts.recurrence:apply: uv run python -m pdf_extract recurrence apply
scripts.label: pnpm --filter labeler build && uv run python -m pdf_extract label serve
